title: Odyssey cold flow reveals an ignition fault
summary: A nitrous-oxide cold flow exercised the feed and data systems and exposed an igniter problem before the next hot-fire attempt.

title: Triton completes two hot fires
summary: A first-year team moved a LOX/ethanol engine from training to two successful tests at Cecil Spaceport in ten months.

title: MOE test data forces a rebuild
summary: An engine anomaly damaged Draco while the team operated remotely. The failure was reviewed, salvageable hardware was identified, and rebuild work began immediately.

title: Five freshmen return Draco to service
summary: First-year members redesigned the LOX and pressurant systems, tank restraints, relief sizing, and thrust structure, returning the stand to operation within weeks.
